tools.name: grant_patient_portal_access
tools.description: Looks up a patient by ID and runs the clinic's portal administration command to give that patient portal access at the requested level (e.g. view-only or full). Returns the command output.

params.name: patient_id
params.description: ID of the patient in the clinic records

params.name: portal_access_level
params.description: Access level to grant, such as 'view' or 'full'

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess

from langchain_core.tools import tool

CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH = "clinic.db"


@tool
def grant_patient_portal_access(patient_id: str, portal_access_level: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH)
    matching_patient_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT full_name, email FROM patients WHERE id = ?", (patient_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()
    if matching_patient_row is None:
        return f"No patient found with id {patient_id}"
    patient_full_name, patient_email_address = matching_patient_row
    completed_command_process = subprocess.run(
        ["clinicctl", "portal", "grant", "--patient", patient_id, "--email", patient_email_address, "--level", portal_access_level],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return f"{patient_full_name}: {completed_command_process.stdout.strip() or completed_command_process.stderr.strip()}"

tools.name: cancel_appointment_and_refund_deposit
tools.description: Cancels an appointment by deleting it from the schedule, refunds the deposit the patient paid through Stripe, and removes the patient's online booking permission. Use for no-show abuse or patient-requested cancellations that need a full refund.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to cancel

params.name: revoke_online_booking
params.description: Whether to also remove the patient's online booking permission

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH = "clinic.db"
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_clinic_placeholder"


@function_tool
def cancel_appointment_and_refund_deposit(appointment_id: int, revoke_online_booking: bool) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        deleted_appointment_rows = database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ? RETURNING patient_id, deposit_payment_intent_id, deposit_amount_cents",
            (appointment_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        if not deleted_appointment_rows:
            database_connection.rollback()
            return f"Appointment {appointment_id} was not found"

        patient_identifier, deposit_payment_intent_identifier, deposit_amount_in_cents = deleted_appointment_rows[0]

        refund_status_message = "no deposit to refund"
        if deposit_payment_intent_identifier and deposit_amount_in_cents:
            created_refund_object = stripe.Refund.create(
                payment_intent=deposit_payment_intent_identifier,
                amount=deposit_amount_in_cents,
                reason="requested_by_customer",
                metadata={"appointment_id": str(appointment_id)},
            )
            refund_status_message = f"refund {created_refund_object.id} is {created_refund_object.status}"

        booking_permission_message = "booking permission unchanged"
        if revoke_online_booking:
            revoked_permission_cursor = database_connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM patient_permissions WHERE patient_id = ? AND permission = 'online_booking'",
                (patient_identifier,),
            )
            booking_permission_message = f"removed {revoked_permission_cursor.rowcount} online booking permission(s)"

        database_connection.commit()
    except Exception as caught_error:
        database_connection.rollback()
        return f"Cancellation failed: {caught_error}"
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    return f"Appointment {appointment_id} cancelled; {refund_status_message}; {booking_permission_message}"

tools.name: archive_signed_intake_form
tools.description: Moves a patient's signed intake form from the front-desk inbox into the archive folder for that patient, then runs the clinic's document indexing script on the archived file.

params.name: patient_id
params.description: ID of the patient the form belongs to

params.name: form_filename
params.description: File name of the intake form inside the inbox folder

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

INTAKE_INBOX_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/clinic/intake_inbox")
PATIENT_ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/clinic/patient_archive")


@tool
def archive_signed_intake_form(patient_id: str, form_filename: str) -> str:
    source_form_path = INTAKE_INBOX_DIRECTORY / Path(form_filename).name
    if not source_form_path.exists():
        return f"Form {form_filename} not found in inbox"
    destination_patient_directory = PATIENT_ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY / patient_id
    destination_patient_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_archived_path = Path(shutil.move(str(source_form_path), str(destination_patient_directory / source_form_path.name)))
    indexing_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/index_document.py", str(final_archived_path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return f"Archived to {final_archived_path} (indexer exit code {indexing_process_result.returncode})"

tools.name: enroll_patient_in_membership_plan
tools.description: Charges the patient's saved card for a clinic membership plan and upgrades the patient's account role to member so they get member booking privileges.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("clinic-appointments")
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_clinic_placeholder"
CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH = "clinic.db"
PLAN_PRICES_IN_CENTS = {"basic": 2900, "premium": 7900}


@mcp.tool()
def enroll_patient_in_membership_plan(patient_id: str, plan_name: str) -> str:
    if not patient_id or not patient_id.strip():
        return "Error: patient_id is required"
    normalized_plan_name = plan_name.strip().lower()
    if normalized_plan_name not in PLAN_PRICES_IN_CENTS:
        return "Error: plan_name must be 'basic' or 'premium'"

    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(CLINIC_DATABASE_PATH)
    patient_billing_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id, stripe_payment_method_id FROM patients WHERE id = ?", (patient_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if patient_billing_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return f"Error: patient {patient_id} not found"
    stripe_customer_id, stripe_payment_method_id = patient_billing_row
    if not stripe_customer_id or not stripe_payment_method_id:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Error: patient has no saved card on file"

    try:
        payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=PLAN_PRICES_IN_CENTS[normalized_plan_name],
            currency="usd",
            customer=stripe_customer_id,
            payment_method=stripe_payment_method_id,
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as stripe_error:
        database_connection.close()
        return f"Error: payment failed: {stripe_error}"

    database_connection.execute("UPDATE patients SET role = 'member' WHERE id = ?", (patient_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Patient {patient_id} enrolled in {normalized_plan_name}; payment {payment_intent.id} {payment_intent.status}"
